editorial:
Imagine waking up one day and realizing everyone you trust has turned against you. That is exactly what happens in this heavy hitter of a movie. You follow a young girl who does the brave thing by reporting a classmate for rape, but instead of getting help, she gets treated like a criminal. From the school principals to her own close friends, the people who should have her back decide to believe the guy instead. It creates a really tense feeling as you watch her get pushed into a corner with nowhere to turn, making you feel her anger and sadness in every scene.

The acting is surprisingly raw, and the movie doesn't shy away from how ugly social pressure can be. While some parts of the plot feel a bit slow, the emotional payoff is worth the wait. If you enjoy stories about underdogs fighting for the truth, you need to see this. It is a tough watch, but it stays with you long after the credits roll.
endingExplained: At the end, the girl stops trying to convince the school and takes matters into her own hands to prove the truth. Through a series of tense confrontations, the rapist finally cracks and admits what he did in front of the people who doubted her. The movie wraps up with her getting some justice, though it shows that the trust she lost with her friends can never truly be fixed. She walks away stronger but changed forever.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves powerful stories about fighting for the truth against all odds.
